name: mirage
text: Found and fixed. The Odds API's free keys get a short 'slow down' (HTTP 429) now and then. My 'stick to one key' rule treated that as a reason to move on, and it never came back, so every burst moved the engine one key further down the list. After a few days all 23 keys were equally used, about 64 each. Now a throttled key is skipped only while it rests (seconds), and the first key that can take a call is always used first, so keys are used in your order and each one is spent before the next. It's tested and committed, but not released, so the engine keeps the old behavior until the next version ships. That version also has the unlimited-bids fix. The credits already spent on the other keys can't be undone, but they have about 87% left.
